items.content: تصور کنید یک ارز دیجیتال تازه‌وارد را در شبکه‌های اجتماعی پیدا کرده‌اید که قیمت آن در چند ساعت ۲۰۰ درصد رشد کرده است. عده‌ای از سودهایشان می‌گویند و بعضی‌ها هم پیش‌بینی می‌کنند قیمت آن چند برابر خواهد شد. اما از کجا می‌توان فهمید این ارز واقعاً ارزش بررسی دارد یا ممکن است سرمایه شما را به خطر بیندازد؟ برای بررسی یک ارز ناشناخته، لازم نیست برنامه‌نویسی بلد باشید یا ساعت‌ها وقت صرف تحلیل داده‌های بلاک چین کنید. ابزارهایی وجود دارند که به شما کمک می‌کنند قرارداد هوشمند، کیف پول‌های بزرگ، نقدینگی و اعتبار پروژه را بررسی کنید. در این مطلب با ۴ ابزار کاربردی و روش استفاده از آن‌ها آشنا می‌شویم. ۱. دکس اسکرینر؛ پیدا کردن آدرس قرارداد و بررسی معاملات اولین قدم برای بررسی یک ارز ناشناخته، پیدا کردن آدرس قرارداد هوشمند آن است. این آدرس از مجموعه‌ای از حروف و اعداد تشکیل شده و برای شناسایی توکن در یک شبکه بلاک چین استفاده می‌شود. از آنجایی که ممکن است چند ارز نام یا نماد یکسانی داشته باشند، بهتر است برای بررسی توکن موردنظر از آدرس قرارداد آن استفاده کنید. سایت دکس اسکرینر (DEX Screener) یکی از ابزارهای کاربردی برای پیدا کردن این آدرس است. این سایت اطلاعات توکن‌هایی را که در صرافی‌های غیرمتمرکز معامله می‌شوند، نمایش می‌دهد و علاوه بر آدرس قرارداد، امکان بررسی قیمت، نقدینگی، حجم معاملات و تعداد خرید و فروش‌ها را فراهم می‌کند. نکته: ارزهای دیجیتال نمایش‌داده‌شده در تصاویر این مقاله صرفاً برای آموزش نحوه استفاده از ابزارها انتخاب شده‌اند و معرفی آن‌ها به معنای تأیید اعتبار، کلاهبرداری بودن یا توصیه به خرید و فروش نیست. چطور از دکس اسکرینر استفاده کنیم؟ وارد سایت دکس اسکرینر شوید و نام یا نماد ارز موردنظر را در کادر جست‌وجو وارد کنید. از میان نتایج، توکن موردنظر را انتخاب کنید. توجه داشته باشید که ممکن است چند توکن با نام مشابه وجود داشته باشند. بنابراین، شبکه و آدرس قرارداد آن را با اطلاعات منتشرشده در منابع رسمی پروژه تطبیق دهید. در صفحه توکن، آدرس قرارداد آن را پیدا و کپی کنید. این آدرس را برای بررسی‌های بعدی نیاز خواهید داشت. . پس از پیدا کردن آدرس قرارداد، نگاهی هم به نمودار قیمت و اطلاعات معاملاتی توکن بیندازید. در ادامه توضیح می‌دهیم که هنگام بررسی این اطلاعات باید به چه نکاتی توجه کنید. برای بررسی وضعیت معاملات یک توکن، ابتدا به نمودار قیمت آن نگاه کنید. ببینید قیمت در چند ساعت یا چند روز گذشته چه مسیری داشته است. رشد ناگهانی و چندبرابری قیمت، به‌خصوص زمانی که پس از آن ریزش شدیدی اتفاق افتاده، می‌تواند نشانه نوسان بالا و رفتار غیرعادی بازار باشد. البته نمودار به‌تنهایی برای تشخیص دستکاری قیمت کافی نیست. در مرحله بعد، نقدینگی (Liquidity) را بررسی کنید. این عدد نشان می‌دهد چه مقدار دارایی در استخر معاملاتی وجود دارد. هرچه نقدینگی کمتر باشد، سفارش‌های خرید و فروش می‌توانند تأثیر بیشتری بر قیمت ارزهای دیجیتال بگذارند. برای مثال، اگر ارزش بازار یک توکن چند میلیون دلار باشد، اما استخر معاملاتی آن فقط ۱۰ هزار دلار نقدینگی داشته باشد، فروش مقدار نسبتاً زیادی از توکن می‌تواند باعث افت شدید قیمت شود. به علامت قفل کنار نقدینگی هم توجه کنید. این علامت به وضعیت قفل یا سوزانده شدن نقدینگی استخر مربوط می‌شود. با کلیک روی آن بررسی کنید چه درصدی از نقدینگی قفل شده و در صورت وجود قفل زمانی، چه زمانی آزاد می‌شود. اگر بخش زیادی از نقدینگی قابل‌برداشت باشد، احتمال خروج ناگهانی آن یکی از خطراتی است که باید در نظر بگیرید. به حجم معاملات (Volume) هم توجه کنید. این شاخص نشان می‌دهد در یک بازه زمانی مشخص، چه مقدار خرید و فروش انجام شده است. حجم معاملات بالا در کنار نقدینگی بسیار کم یا نوسانات شدید قیمت می‌تواند نشانه‌ای برای بررسی دقیق‌تر توکن باشد. حالا که آدرس قرارداد را پیدا کرده‌اید و وضعیت معاملات را بررسی کرده‌اید، نوبت به بررسی امنیت خود توکن می‌رسد. برای این کار می‌توانید از ابزار بعدی، یعنی کوئیک اینتل (Quick Intel)، استفاده کنید. ۲. کوئیک اینتل؛ بررسی امنیت قرارداد و شناسایی هانی‌پات یکی از خطرات خرید ارزهای ناشناخته، گرفتار شدن در تله کلاهبرداری هانی‌ پات است. در این روش کلاهبرداری، کاربران می‌توانند یک توکن را بخرند، اما هنگام فروش با مشکل مواجه می‌شوند. گاهی هم کارمزد فروش آن‌قدر بالاست که عملاً بخش بزرگی از سرمایه خریدار از بین می‌رود. سایت کوئیک اینتل برای شناسایی چنین خطراتی طراحی شده است. این ابزار قرارداد هوشمند توکن را بررسی می‌کند و درباره قابلیت‌های مشکوک آن هشدار می‌دهد. برای مثال، می‌تواند نشان دهد سازنده امکان ایجاد توکن جدید، مسدود کردن برخی آدرس‌ها یا تغییر کارمزد معاملات را دارد یا نه. مزیت مهم کوئیک اینتل پشتیبانی از ده‌ها شبکه بلاک چینی، از جمله اتریوم، سولانا، بی‌ان‌بی چین، بیس، ترون و سویی است. البته امکانات بررسی در همه شبکه‌ها یکسان نیستند. چطور از Quick Intel استفاده کنیم؟ وارد بخش اسکنر Quick Intel شوید. شبکه‌ای را که توکن روی آن راه‌اندازی شده است را انتخاب کنید. آدرس قرارداد توکن را در کادر جست‌وجو قرار دهید و گزینه Scan را بزنید. نتیجه بررسی را بخوانید و به هشدارهای مربوط به هانی‌پات، کارمزد فروش و اختیارات مالک توجه کنید. هنگام بررسی قرارداد هوشمند در Quick Intel، به این موارد توجه کنید: هانی‌پات (Honeypot): ممکن است بتوانید توکن را بخرید، اما قرارداد اجازه فروش آن را ندهد و سرمایه‌تان در آن گرفتار شود. کارمزد فروش (Sell Tax): اگر سازنده اختیار تغییر کارمزد را داشته باشد، ممکن است آن را مثلاً از ۵ به ۹۰ درصد برساند و بخش بزرگی از مبلغ فروش شما کسر شود. قابلیت ایجاد توکن (Mint): سازنده ممکن است بتواند توکن‌های جدیدی تولید کند. افزایش ناگهانی عرضه می‌تواند باعث کاهش قیمت شود. فهرست سیاه (Blacklist): سازنده ممکن است بتواند آدرس کیف پول شما را مسدود کند تا امکان انتقال یا فروش توکن‌هایتان را نداشته باشید. اختیارات مالک قرارداد (Ownership): بررسی کنید آیا سازنده همچنان می‌تواند تنظیمات مهم قرارداد را تغییر دهد یا کنترل آن را به آدرس دیگری منتقل کند. نکته: عبارت Passed یعنی توکن در آن بررسی امنیتی قبول شده و مشکل مشخصی شناسایی نشده است. البته این نتیجه به معنی تضمین امنیت کامل توکن نیست. وجود هرکدام از این قابلیت‌ها به‌تنهایی اثبات‌کننده کلاهبرداری نیست، اما می‌تواند اختیاراتی در اختیار سازنده قرار دهد که برای خریداران خطرآفرین باشد. نسخه اولیه اسکنر رایگان است، اما بعضی اطلاعات تکمیلی به سطح دسترسی بالاتری نیاز دارند. ۳. بابل مپز؛ شناسایی ارتباط کیف پول‌های بزرگ سالم بودن قرارداد هوشمند به این معنی نیست که توکن از نظر توزیع عرضه هم وضعیت مناسبی دارد. ممکن است بخش بزرگی از توکن‌ها در اختیار چند کیف پول باشد و فروش هم‌زمان آن‌ها قیمت را به‌شدت کاهش دهد. بابل مپز اطلاعات دارندگان توکن را به‌شکل یک نقشه حبابی نمایش می‌دهد. هر حباب نماینده یک کیف پول است و اندازه آن نشان می‌دهد چه مقدار توکن در اختیار دارد. خط‌هایی که حباب‌ها را به هم وصل می‌کنند نیز از انتقال دارایی میان آن آدرس‌ها خبر می‌دهند. این ویژگی کمک می‌کند ارتباطات میان دارندگان بزرگ را ببینید و بررسی کنید آیا عرضه توکن در چند کیف پول مرتبط متمرکز شده است یا نه. بابل مپز از شبکه‌های مختلفی از جمله اتریوم، سولانا، بی‌ان‌بی چین، بیس و ترون پشتیبانی می‌کند. چطور از Bubblemaps استفاده کنیم؟ وارد Bubblemaps شوید و گزینه Launch App را انتخاب کنید. شبکه موردنظر را مشخص کرده و آدرس قرارداد توکن را جست‌وجو کنید. نقشه حباب‌ها را بررسی کنید. حباب‌های بزرگ نشان‌دهنده دارندگانی با سهم بالای توکن هستند. روی حباب‌ها کلیک کنید تا درصد مالکیت و ارتباط آن‌ها با سایر کیف پول‌ها را ببینید. فرض کنید پنج کیف پول مختلف هرکدام ۶ درصد از عرضه یک توکن را در اختیار دارند. در نگاه اول ممکن است این توزیع عادی به نظر برسد، اما اگر همه این کیف پول‌ها با یکدیگر ارتباط داشته باشند، احتمال دارد بخش قابل‌توجهی از عرضه تحت کنترل یک گروه باشد. در چنین شرایطی، باید تاریخچه انتقال توکن‌ها و هویت احتمالی کیف پول‌ها را هم بررسی کنید. وجود ارتباط میان چند کیف پول به‌تنهایی دلیل کلاهبرداری نیست. برخی آدرس‌های بزرگ متعلق به صرافی‌ها، قراردادهای نقدینگی یا خزانه پروژه هستند و نباید آن‌ها را با کیف پول سرمایه‌گذاران عادی یکسان دانست. ۴. چت جی‌پی‌تی، کلاود یا جمنای؛ تحقیق درباره اعتبار و سابقه پروژه سه ابزار قبلی به شما کمک می‌کنند وضعیت فنی قرارداد، ارتباط کیف پول‌ها و شرایط معاملات را بررسی کنید. اما هنوز یک سؤال مهم باقی می‌ماند: چه کسانی پشت این پروژه هستند و چه سابقه‌ای دارند؟ اینجاست که ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی می‌توانند کاربرد داشته باشند. برای مثال، می‌توانید از مدل هوش مصنوعی دلخواه خود بخواهید درباره توسعه‌دهندگان پروژه در منابع انگلیسی تحقیق کنند، اخبار و حواشی مرتبط را پیدا کنند و گزارش‌های حسابرسی امنیتی را به زبان ساده توضیح دهند. حتی اگر در تفسیر اطلاعات هر ۳ ابزار قبلی به کمک نیاز داشتید، کافیست اسکرین شات صفحه مورد نظر خود را به چت‌ جی‌پی‌تی، کلاود یا جمنای بدهید تا آن را به زبان ساده برای شما توضیح دهد. این ابزارها به‌خصوص زمانی مفیدند که اطلاعات یک پروژه در چند وب‌سایت، شبکه اجتماعی و گزارش مختلف پراکنده شده باشد. چطور با هوش مصنوعی درباره یک توکن تحقیق کنیم؟ وارد سایت یا اپلیکیشن مدل هوش مصنوعی موردنظر خود شوید. نام پروژه، شبکه بلاک چینی، وب‌سایت رسمی و آدرس قرارداد آن را وارد کنید. درخواست کنید سوابق تیم سازنده، اخبار منفی، گزارش‌های حسابرسی و ادعاهای مهم پروژه بررسی شوند. از مدل بخواهید برای هر ادعای مهم لینک منبع معتبر ارائه کند و موارد تأییدنشده را مشخص کند. برای این کار می‌توانید از متن زیر استفاده کنید: می‌خواهم درباره ارز دیجیتال [نام پروژه] در شبکه [نام شبکه] تحقیق کنم. آدرس قرارداد آن [آدرس قرارداد] است. لطفاً با جست‌وجو در منابع معتبر انگلیسی، سوابق تیم توسعه‌دهنده، گزارش‌های امنیتی، اخبار منفی، ادعاهای کلاهبرداری و مشکلات احتمالی پروژه را بررسی کن. برای هر مورد منبع و تاریخ ارائه بده و مشخص کن چه اطلاعاتی تأیید شده و چه مواردی صرفاً ادعا هستند. در پایان، ریسک‌هایی را که پیش از خرید باید بررسی کنم توضیح بده. همچنین اگر کد تأییدشده قرارداد هوشمند یا گزارش حسابرسی پروژه را در اختیار دارید، می‌توانید از هوش مصنوعی بخواهید بخش‌های مهم آن را توضیح دهد. فقط توجه داشته باشید که هوش مصنوعی جایگزین حسابرسی امنیتی قرارداد نیست. این مدل‌ها ممکن است اطلاعات اشتباه ارائه کنند، منابع را نادرست تفسیر کنند یا در صورت نداشتن دسترسی به وب، از اخبار تازه بی‌اطلاع باشند. بنابراین، حتماً لینک‌های ارائه‌شده را بررسی کنید و نتیجه را صرفاً بر اساس پاسخ مدل نپذیرید. دو ابزار دیگر برای بررسی امنیت ارزهای ناشناخته علاوه بر سایت‌های معرفی‌شده، دو ابزار زیر هم برای بررسی خطرات احتمالی توکن‌ها کاربرد دارند: هانی‌پات دات‌ایز ( Honeypot.is ) : با شبیه‌سازی خرید و فروش توکن، بررسی می‌کند که آیا امکان فروش آن وجود دارد یا ممکن است سرمایه خریدار در تله هانی‌پات گرفتار شود. گوپلاس سکیوریتی ( GoPlus Security ) : قرارداد هوشمند توکن‌ها را در شبکه‌های مختلف بررسی می‌کند و درباره قابلیت‌های خطرناک مانند ایجاد توکن جدید، مسدود کردن فروش و تغییر کارمزد هشدار می‌دهد. نشانه‌های هشدار در پروژه‌های ارز دیجیتال علاوه بر بررسی‌های فنی، باید به ادعاها و رفتارهای تیم سازنده هم توجه کنید. برخی از رایج‌ترین نشانه‌های هشدار عبارت‌اند از: وعده سود تضمینی: اگر پروژه‌ای ادعا می‌کند قیمت توکن آن حتماً چند برابر می‌شود یا سود مشخصی را تضمین می‌کند، باید به اعتبار این وعده شک کنید. هیچ‌کس نمی‌تواند رشد قیمت یک ارز دیجیتال را تضمین کند. اصرار به خرید فوری: عباراتی مثل «فقط چند ساعت فرصت دارید» یا «اگر الان نخرید، سود بزرگی را از دست می‌دهید» ممکن است برای تحت فشار قرار دادن سرمایه‌گذاران استفاده شوند. اجبار به خرید مقدار مشخص: اگر از شما می‌خواهند برای فعال شدن حساب، دریافت سود یا آزادسازی دارایی‌ها حتماً مقدار مشخصی توکن بخرید، دلیل این شرط را بررسی کنید. البته وجود حداقل مبلغ خرید به‌تنهایی نشانه کلاهبرداری نیست. درخواست پرداخت پول برای برداشت دارایی: بعضی کلاهبرداران پس از واریز سرمایه، به بهانه‌هایی مثل مالیات، تأیید حساب یا رفع مسدودی، پول بیشتری درخواست می‌کنند. پرداخت این مبلغ معمولاً به آزاد شدن دارایی منجر نمی‌شود. درخواست عبارت بازیابی کیف پول: هیچ پروژه معتبری برای خرید توکن، بررسی حساب یا دریافت پاداش به عبارت بازیابی یا کلید خصوصی کیف پول شما نیاز ندارد. ارائه این اطلاعات می‌تواند به سرقت دارایی‌هایتان منجر شود. آیا عبور از این بررسی‌ها به معنای امن بودن خرید است؟ خیر. حتی اگر قرارداد یک توکن مشکل شناخته‌شده‌ای نداشته باشد، توزیع عرضه آن مناسب به نظر برسد و سابقه منفی مشخصی هم از تیم سازنده پیدا نکنید، همچنان احتمال زیان وجود دارد. ارزهای ترند و ناشناخته ممکن است در مدت کوتاهی رشد چندبرابری داشته باشند، اما ریسک سقوط شدید قیمت و کلاهبرداری نیز در میان آن‌ها بالاست. بعضی خطرات حتی پس از خرید ظاهر می‌شوند. برای مثال، سازندگان ممکن است نقدینگی را خارج کنند، کیف پول‌های بزرگ شروع به فروش کنند یا قیمت به دلیل کاهش تقاضا سقوط کند. در مجموع، این چهار ابزار به شما کمک می‌کنند برخی نشانه‌های خطر را پیش از خرید شناسایی کنید، اما نتایج آن‌ها به‌تنهایی برای قضاوت قطعی درباره یک پروژه کافی نیست. برای مثال، وجود قابلیت ایجاد توکن جدید یا تمرکز عرضه در چند کیف پول مرتبط، لزوماً به معنای کلاهبرداری نیست و ممکن است دلایل مشخصی داشته باشد. از طرف دیگر، حتی اگر هیچ هشدار امنیتی دریافت نکنید، باز هم احتمال دارد پروژه با مشکلاتی روبه‌رو شود که این ابزارها قادر به شناسایی آن‌ها نیستند. بنابراین، بهتر است نتایج بررسی‌ها را در کنار اطلاعات مربوط به تیم سازنده، سابقه پروژه و شرایط بازار ارزیابی کنید و هیچ‌کدام را تضمینی برای امنیت یا سودآوری توکن ندانید. به همین دلیل، اگر قصد خرید چنین ارزهایی را دارید، بهتر است ابتدا با مبلغ کمی شروع کنید و فقط بخشی از سرمایه‌تان را وارد معامله کنید که توانایی از دست دادن کامل آن را دارید. همچنین بهتر است تمام سرمایه خود را روی یک توکن ناشناخته قرار ندهید. The post قبل از خرید ارزهای ترند، بهتر است این ۴ سایت را بررسی کنید! appeared first on ارزدیجیتال .

items.content: در شرایطی که فاصله میان درآمد و هزینه‌های زندگی به یکی از دغدغه‌های اصلی کارگران تبدیل شده، نمایندگان مجلس به دنبال تغییر سازوکار تعیین حداقل دستمزد هستند. در همین رابطه علی جعفری‌آذر، نایب‌رییس کمیسیون اجتماعی مجلس، از تصویب کلیات طرح اصلاح ماده ۴۱ قانون کار در این کمیسیون خبر داد و گفت: براساس پیشنهاد مطرح‌شده، حداقل حقوق کارگران باید متناسب با نرخ تورم اعلام‌شده از سوی بانک مرکزی تعیین شود.

items.title: Patriots' season on the brink as Drake Maye's injury could keep him out for rest of year
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Drake Maye could miss the rest of the season after a lower-leg injury on an Aidan Hutchinson sack during the New England Patriots' loss in Munich.
items.content: The New England Patriots were in the Super Bowl merely nine months ago. On Monday morning, they find themselves on the brink of complete disaster. Drake Maye is expected to miss significant time due to a lower-leg injury he suffered in Sunday’s loss against the Detroit Lions in Munich, according to multiple reports. The NFL Network reported that Maye could possibly miss the remainder of the season. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! The injury occurred early in the Patriots’ 35-10 loss to the Detroit Lions. Maye was trying to avoid a sack when he ran into the arms of Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson. Maye went down and was seen limping off the field and into the locker room. Ironically, Hutchinson also suffered a significant knee injury when he leaped and pumped his fist to celebrate the sack. His knee buckled on the way down and he is feared to be out for the rest of the season. The Patriots put Tommy DeVito into the game. He was 12-of-24 for 81 yards with a touchdown pass and an interception. The New England offense sputtered and couldn’t really get anything going as Jared Goff threw for 303 yards, three touchdowns and two interceptions. New England head coach Mike Vrabel said Maye "couldn’t play, couldn’t run, couldn’t do whatever he needed to do to play quarterback, to protect himself, to execute, or function at that level." CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE The possibility of Hutchinson using a hip-drop tackle technique being the catalyst for Maye’s injury was also brought up during Vrabel’s postgame press conference. The FOX broadcast also mentioned the tackle when it came to Maye’s injury. Vrabel said he didn’t think the tackle was improper. "I'm not going to assume there was something there," Vrabel said. "However it happened, I don’t think it was anything intentional. I’m sure that it wasn’t. That’s part of the game." New England sat at 5-5 after the defeat. A Buffalo Bills win over the New York Jets increased the Patriots’ deficit in the AFC East. The Patriots are four games behind the Bills in the loss column. The Patriots will have a bye week in Week 11 before going on the road to face the Los Angeles Chargers.

items.title: Pompeii home buried by Mount Vesuvius yields personal treasures untouched for nearly 2,000 years
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: A woman's cabinet sealed since Mount Vesuvius erupted in A.D. 79 held a children's amulet necklace, perfume bottle, bronze coins and makeup tools, archaeologists found.
items.content: Archaeologists excavating a home in ancient Pompeii recently uncovered the remains of an ancient Roman cabinet — revealing intimate belongings buried for nearly 2,000 years. The discovery was announced by Pompeii Archaeological Park. Officials said in a press release in late October, which was translated from Italian, that the cabinet was discovered in house IX 11, 7, also known as the House of Cornelius Maximus, along the Via dell'Abbondanza. HIDDEN UNDERGROUND CHAMBER REVEALED BENEATH HOME OF LEGENDARY ROMAN EMPEROR The cabinet — which officials believe belonged to a woman — had apparently remained unopened since Mount Vesuvius erupted in 79 A.D. Using clues from the excavation, archaeologists were able to determine what the cabinet originally looked like and identify the belongings stored inside. Pictures released by officials show ancient pottery and other artifacts uncovered during the excavation. The cabinet contained tweezers, a tool for mixing makeup and a glass perfume bottle , as well as an incense burner, a bronze oil lamp and lead weights. SUNKEN ROYAL PALACE WITH CLEOPATRA LINK YIELDS RARE FIND TIED TO LONG-LOST WONDER OF ANCIENT WORLD Among the discoveries was a necklace made up of at least 24 miniature charms, including depictions of gods, hands, feet, pine cones and bunches of grapes. Such necklaces, known as crepundia, were given to Roman children as protective amulets . They also made noise as children moved, which allowed adults to hear them. Officials believe the owner may have retained the necklace as a childhood keepsake. "Adults sometimes kept these objects, often in small boxes or, as in this case, in cloth bags inside cabinets, evidently as reminders of a childhood of which little else sometimes remained," officials said. ANCIENT BURIAL REVEALS RARE JEWELRY FIND THAT ARCHAEOLOGISTS CALL 'HIGHLY UNUSUAL' Archaeologists also discovered a small hoard of 38 bronze coins , though the denominations were not specified, leaving their monetary value unclear. "The presence of the coins, in particular, suggests that the female owner or owners did not have time to retrieve their possessions of economic or sentimental value," officials said. The inhabitants of the residence may have fled during the eruption but never returned to recover their belongings, unlike others who apparently returned to dig for their possessions, according to evidence from recent excavations. "But perhaps they did not survive. ... These are questions destined to remain unanswered," the release added. CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER Gabriel Zuchtriegel, director of Pompeii Archaeological Park , said in a statement that the objects found at the excavation site "bring the human dimension of the past back to life." Said Zuchtriegel, "We cannot reconstruct with certainty the identity of those who lived in the house, but these fragments bring us closer to their everyday lives." The excavation also revealed elaborate wall paintings inside the home, suggesting its residents were relatively well-off. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE NEWS Construction work was underway when Mount Vesuvius erupted, however, which may have disrupted daily life in the home. Archaeologists also found the skeletons of at least two young mice inside a storage vessel on a mezzanine level. The mice were likely wood mice, which commonly make their way into homes looking for food — a reminder that ancient Romans dealt with unwanted household pests, much like people today. TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ The find is one of many discoveries made at Pompeii in recent years. Earlier this year, archaeologists uncovered 2,000-year-old love notes etched into a wall, using advanced imaging technology to reveal inscriptions that had long gone unnoticed. Last year, archaeologists found the remains of at least four people, including a child, in a Pompeii home where residents had tried to shield themselves from the eruption by barricading a door with a bed.

items.title: Browns make NFL history as they storm back to pick up sixth win of season over Texans
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Deshaun Watson engineered another fourth-quarter comeback as the Cleveland Browns erased a 17-point deficit to stun C.J. Stroud's Texans 27-24.
items.content: Usually, when the Cleveland Browns and history are in the same sentence, it’s not good. But it appears the tables have turned through the first 10 weeks of the 2026 NFL season. Deshaun Watson led the offense on another game-winning fourth-quarter drive to put Cleveland up three points with 53 seconds left in the game. The Browns shut down Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud on his final drive and Cleveland overcame a 17-point deficit to stun Houston 27-24. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! The Browns moved to 6-4 on the season. Each of their six wins have come within one score. It’s the first time in NFL history a team has won its first six games by four points or fewer, according to ESPN Insights. Cleveland is also 4-0 at home for the first time since 1963. "I don’t have the end of the story," Browns head coach Todd Monken said when asked how the team keeps finding ways to win. "I just know if our guys keep fighting, keep battling, keep scratching and clawing, they always have a chance." In five of their six wins, the Browns had to dig themselves out of a hole. Cleveland was down 10 points against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers before picking up a win in Week 2. The Carolina Panthers were leading Cleveland 18-13 in the fourth quarter when Watson found a way to win the game in the closing two minutes. The Baltimore Ravens were up 10-0 in the first quarter before the Browns came back. The Tennessee Titans found themselves up 14-0 early before giving the game away. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE The Texans found themselves up 17-0 early in the game before the Browns’ defense turned things around and helped the offense get into position to strike. Watson even threw a fourth-quarter interception that might have sealed the game if the Texans didn’t go four-and-out on their next drive. "This is what I’ve been working on, working for, my whole career," Watson said, later adding, "People create stories and narratives. But my actions speak louder than my words." Cleveland will enter its bye week in the thick of the AFC North race. On Nov. 29, they will welcome the Las Vegas Raiders into town. The Associated Press contributed to this report.

items.preview: عاملان قدرت‌نمایی و نزاع در تهران پس از شناسایی، توسط پلیس دستگیری، شدند. متهم حین عملیات قصد درگیری و فرار داشت که با شلیک دقیق مأموران و اصابت گلوله به پای وی، زمین‌گیر و دستگیر شد. در عملیات دستگیری این افراد چند نفر از اراذل و اوباش بخاطر مقاومت و درگیری با پلیس، مورد هدف گلو
items.content: عاملان قدرت‌نمایی و نزاع در تهران پس از شناسایی، توسط پلیس دستگیری، شدند. متهم حین عملیات قصد درگیری و فرار داشت که با شلیک دقیق مأموران و اصابت گلوله به پای وی، زمین‌گیر و دستگیر شد. در عملیات دستگیری این افراد چند نفر از اراذل و اوباش بخاطر مقاومت و درگیری با پلیس، مورد هدف گلوله پلیس قرار گرفته‌اند. سر کرده این باند در پرونده‌هایی از جمله شرارت و درگیری، اخلال در نظم عمومی، تخریب و تیراندازی دارای سابقه بودند و به باند مرغی‌ها معروف بودند. سرهنگ سعید راستی، معاون مبارزه با شرارت پلیس امنیت عمومی فراجا با اشاره به سوابق متهمان در زمینه درگیری، اخلال در نظم عمومی، تخریب و تیراندازی خاطرنشان کرد: پس از تشکیل پرونده، متهمان برای طی مراحل قانونی به مرجع قضایی معرفی شدند.

items.title: Dem eyeing Homeland Security committee's oversight subcommittee gavel aims 'to dismantle DHS from the inside'
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: A Democrat seeking the chairmanship of the House Homeland Security Committee's Oversight, Investigations and Accountability Subcommittee, wants "to dismantle DHS from the inside."
items.content: A Democrat, who noted that she is seeking the House Homeland Security Committee's Oversight, Investigations and Accountability Subcommittee chair, said that she aims "to dismantle" the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) "from the inside." "I introduced a bill to dismantle DHS, and I intend to dismantle DHS from the inside. Every investigation we do — whether it’s about detention, who is profiting at the expense of children who are literally in cages, or the expansion of these 287(g) agreements where local police [work] with federal agents to hunt down people — is critical to provide the evidence necessary to be able to bring the most justice," she said Tuesday to Mother Jones, which noted that the discussion with the lawmaker had been edited for the sake of length and clarity. Ramirez reportedly said that "there’s no other agency that has consolidated the amount of power that DHS has with the amount of money that DHS has in order to terrorize the American people and literally rob us from our civil rights, while at the same time saying that they’re doing it under the guise of protecting us from terrorism. There is no democracy if DHS continues to operate the way it does." 'SQUAD' DEMOCRAT FORMALLY INTRODUCES BILL TO ABOLISH ICE, BORDER PATROL AND DISMANTLE DHS "For me, investigations must lead into reimagining something new, where we protect cybersecurity infrastructure, where we protect FEMA, where we protect TSA, where we protect the customs functions at the border, and where we abolish ICE and CBP and reinvest funds towards healthcare, community safety and first responders," she said, according to the report. Ramirez, who has served in the House since early 2023, just won re-election during the 2026 midterms. Democrats will have the majorities in both chambers of Congress next year, and the congresswoman noted to Mother Jones that she is "pursuing the Homeland Security Oversight Subcommittee gavel." 'SQUAD' DEMOCRAT SLAMMED BY TRUMP ADMIN FOR MOST 'RADICAL' PLAN TARGETING ICE YET She asserted that "there is no affordability without accountability. Point-blank. If you want to actually talk about why people are living and experiencing the challenges they are right now, whether it’s that they can’t afford to buy groceries, they can’t afford to drive to work or pick up their kids, or they can’t afford the rent or buy their home, or why they’re living in the shadows and their businesses are shutting down, there has to be accountability to the actors that have made that happen. And it also means accountability to those that have terrorized them," she told the outlet. "Yes, we should be passing Medicare for All. Yes, we need to pass a bill that increases wages in this country. Yes, we should abolish super PACs and tax the rich. But we also have to understand that, as we fight for an affordable country, we have to hold every fascist in this administration accountable," Ramirez added. DEMS PIVOT FROM 'AFFORDABILITY' PITCH TO DHS PROBE THREATS AFTER MIDTERM WINS The White House , DHS and Ramirez's office did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's requests for comment.

items.title: Mamdani guts elite NYPD tactical unit, backs 'civilian-led approach' to responding to protests
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Zohran Mamdani disbands the NYPD Strategic Response Group and unveils a civilian-led dialogue team to handle New York City protest response.
items.content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced the disbanding of the NYPD's Strategic Response Group (SRG) on Monday, saying the city will now pursue a "civilian-led approach" to responding to protests . Mamdani made the announcement alongside Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch, stating that the SRG's counterterrorism functions will be folded into an existing command, while a brand-new organization will now lead protest response, the Community Dialogue and De-escalation Division (CDDD). The CDDD, which will lie within the Mayor's Office of Community Safety, will work to "improve the NYPD's protest response" via a specialized "dialogue team," known as the First Amendment Support Team (FAST), they said. "The CDDD will not have weapons or arrest powers. FAST will consist of 30 uniformed officers trained in communication and de-escalation. The NYPD will also establish a new Patrol Support Division (PSD), a unit within the NYPD’s Patrol Services Bureau, with vetted officers who will spend most of their time on patrol-related duties and receive specialized crowd management training to support responses to demonstrations," the mayor's office said in a statement. NYC MAYOR ZOHRAN MAMDANI SAYS HE WON'T FIRE NYPD COMMISSIONER JESSICA TISCH DESPITE SOCIALIST PRESSURE "During our campaign, I promised New Yorkers that we would disband the Strategic Response Group and separate counterterrorism from protest response, and today we are delivering on that promise," Mamdani said in a statement. MINNEAPOLIS PROGRESSIVES TURN ON GEORGE FLOYD-ERA PUBLIC SAFETY OVERHAUL, PUSH TO DISMANTLE OFFICE "New Yorkers exercising their constitutional right to protest should not be met with the same police response as a terrorism threat . We are establishing a new, civilian-led approach that prioritizes dialogue, engagement and de-escalation," he added. The reforms also impose new restrictions on the tools police are allowed to use when responding to protests, including codified bans on kettling, long guns and tear gas. Pepper spray will also not be used as a crowd management tool, and "long-range acoustic devices" will be limited to 90 decibels. MAMDANI, NYPD GIVE SECURITY UPDATE AHEAD OF JEWISH HIGH HOLY DAYS, 9/11 25TH ANNIVERSARY Under the previous structure, the NYPD said the SRG responded to citywide mobilizations, civil disorders and major events and was a "critical asset" during parades, protests and the papal visit. SRG personnel were "also deployed to areas requiring an increased police presence due to increased crime or other conditions" and "mobilizes for shootings, bank robberies, missing persons, demonstrations, or other significant incidents," according to the department. Tisch noted at a March budget hearing that the SRG did not typically deal with peaceful protests, but was deployed for protests that involved criminal activity. She also noted that in 2025, the NYPD facilitated 4,255 protests and the SRG was available at 245 of them, or roughly 6%.

items.title: فایننشال تایمز: جنگ با ایران و افزایش تورم، قدرت خرید شهروندان کشورهای خلیج فارس را کاهش داد
items.author: پایگاه خبری جماران | اخبار روز ایران و جهان
items.preview: روزنامه انگلیسی «فایننشال تایمز» در گزارشی اقتصادی به بررسی پیامدهای جنگ با ایران بر قدرت خرید خانوارها، صنعت خرده‌فروشی و گردشگری کشورهای حاشیه خلیج فارس پرداخته و گزارش داده است که افزایش هزینه واردات، اختلال در زنجیره تأمین کالا و کاهش اعتماد مصرف‌کنندگان، به افت فروش و سودآور
items.content: روزنامه انگلیسی «فایننشال تایمز» در گزارشی اقتصادی به بررسی پیامدهای جنگ با ایران بر قدرت خرید خانوارها، صنعت خرده‌فروشی و گردشگری کشورهای حاشیه خلیج فارس پرداخته و گزارش داده است که افزایش هزینه واردات، اختلال در زنجیره تأمین کالا و کاهش اعتماد مصرف‌کنندگان، به افت فروش و سودآوری شماری از بزرگ‌ترین شرکت‌های منطقه منجر شده است. براساس این گزارش، سود شرکت «لولو ریتیل» ۲۸ درصد، درآمد بخش خرده‌فروشی «ماجد الفطیم» ۶ درصد و درآمد «دبی دیوتی‌فری» ۲۵.۳ درصد کاهش یافته است. فایننشال تایمز همچنین با اشاره به تعدیل صدها نیروی کار، کاهش حضور گردشگران ثروتمند و گرایش خانوارها به کالاها و برندهای ارزان‌تر هشدار می‌دهد که تداوم جنگ و تورم می‌تواند الگوی اقتصادی مبتنی بر گردشگری و مصرف در کشورهای خلیج فارس را با چالش‌های بلندمدت مواجه کند.

items.title: New religious freedom rankings reveal surprising state divide as legal expert warns of costly burdens
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Michigan scored just 34% in the 2026 Faith and Freedom Index, ranking last for religious freedom protections affecting faith-based nonprofits.
items.content: FIRST ON FOX : Michigan has been ranked last in the nation for legal protections affecting faith-based nonprofits, while Alabama took the top spot in Napa Legal Institute's 2026 Faith and Freedom Index, according to a new report obtained by Fox News Digital that highlights unexpected differences between Republican- and Democratic-led states. The 2026 Faith and Freedom Index, released Monday by Napa Legal Institute, evaluates laws in all 50 states and Washington, D.C., that affect religious organizations , including churches, religious schools, pregnancy resource centers and homeless shelters. The findings, shared with Fox News Digital, show Michigan receiving an overall score of just 34%, followed by Washington at 38% and Massachusetts at 41%. SUPREME COURT OFFERS SUPPORT FOR CATHOLIC PRESCHOOLS CHALLENGING STATE FUNDING REQUIREMENTS Napa Legal senior counsel Frank DeVito told Fox News Digital that Michigan's low score reflects what he described as burdensome nondiscrimination requirements, inadequate religious exemptions and regulatory obstacles affecting faith-based organizations. DeVito said Michigan law can create conflicts for Catholic schools and other religious institutions seeking to make hiring and admissions decisions consistent with their beliefs. He also pointed to financial reporting requirements that he said can impose significant costs on religious nonprofits, potentially diverting resources away from education, charitable services and assistance to vulnerable communities. At the opposite end of the rankings, Alabama led the nation with 80%, followed by Kansas at 76%, Indiana at 75% and Texas at 71%. WASHINGTON FOSTER PARENTS SCORE LEGAL VICTORY AFTER STATE DEMANDED THEY USE CHILDREN'S PREFERRED PRONOUNS But some of the report's most striking findings defy traditional political expectations. New York, a Democratic-led state, scored higher overall than Republican-led North Dakota, South Carolina and Tennessee, while some traditionally conservative states trailed Democratic-led states in certain categories of legal protections. DeVito said New York has stronger exemptions from "nondiscrimination" laws in employment and public programming than Tennessee and that a New York state court ruling found the state's constitution provides greater protections for the free exercise of religion than the federal First Amendment. CATHOLIC NUNS SUE NEW YORK, SAY ASSISTED SUICIDE LAW FORCES THEM TO VIOLATE THEIR FAITH The findings underscore how state laws, not just Supreme Court decisions or congressional legislation, can shape the ability of religious organizations to operate, according to Napa Legal. According to Napa Legal Institute, several states have strengthened protections for faith-based nonprofits in recent years. ONE OF NATION'S LARGEST CHRISTIAN FOSTER AGENCIES WILL NOT ALLOW LGBTQ COUPLES TO ADOPT CHILDREN In Florida, lawmakers updated the state's nonprofit corporation laws to clarify that directors of religious organizations can seek guidance from faith leaders, including priests, ministers and rabbis, when making decisions involving religious matters. Meanwhile, Massachusetts and Rhode Island eased certain financial reporting requirements for nonprofits. Massachusetts increased the annual revenue threshold that triggers a mandatory independent audit for nonprofits raising funds in the state from $200,000 to $500,000 , while Rhode Island doubled its audit threshold from $500,000 to $1 million , according to the institute. DeVito stressed the importance of lawmakers establishing lasting legal protections for religious organizations, arguing that churches and faith-based nonprofits provide essential services. VERMONT PAYS $566K IN DAMAGES, LEGAL FEES TO CHRISTIAN SCHOOL IT BANNED FROM ALL SPORTS COMPETITIONS FOR YEARS "For policymakers and government leaders, it's really important to put these laws on the books because the church, the religious organizations do needed work," DeVito said. "They educate children often in poor and disadvantaged circumstances. They feed the hungry, they help the most vulnerable people in society. They do something with the level of love and attention that the government never can." "We need religious organizations to thrive," he continued. "If we are not attentive to the laws being such that these organizations can just do their work rather than spend their time and their money and their resources on administrative burdens that I think are frankly not necessary or fighting lawsuits over, you know, religious liberty issues that they shouldn't have to fight." DeVito warned that burdensome regulations and costly legal battles can divert time and resources away from religious organizations' missions, ultimately hurting society as a whole. He urged lawmakers in both parties to prioritize stronger religious liberty protections, including exemptions from certain nondiscrimination laws and tax requirements, even when doing so presents political or budgetary challenges. Fox News Digital reached out to Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer for comment on the report but did not immediately receive a response.

items.title: Woman’s kratom addiction spiraled from 4 capsules to 100 a day: ‘Zombie shell of myself’
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Hilary Tesluck shares how kratom capsules led to a spiraling addiction, with her daily intake climbing to 100 capsules before she sought help.
items.content: Kratom-related reports to U.S. poison centers rose about 1,200% from 2015 to 2025, reaching a record high of 3,434 last year, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. For Hilary Tesluck, a 30-year-old woman in Michigan, the potential for addiction began well before those numbers emerged. Tesluck, who now works to raise awareness of kratom addiction and support others in recovery, said she first tried kratom capsules in 2017 at age 21. KRATOM INDUSTRY WARNS SYNTHETIC OPIOIDS SHOULD NOT BE CALLED 'KRATOM' Her initial use involved leaf kratom rather than concentrated 7-OH products , she shared. The American Kratom Association argues that 7-OH should be distinguished from natural leaf kratom, while acknowledging that kratom itself can cause dependence. "It was introduced to me by a friend who knew that I was someone who suffered from anxiety and took prescription medication for it," Tesluck told Fox News Digital. "I wanted to be more holistic and natural in what I was consuming." She noted that she doesn’t recall any dosing recommendations on the label. "I didn’t know how much to take, but my friend told me to take four capsules." WHAT IS KRATOM? RISKS OF POPULAR SUBSTANCE REVEALED AFTER COLLEGE STUDENTS' DEATHS At first, Tesluck – an undergraduate student at the time, who was also conducting research and tutoring – noticed the substance gave her a boost in energy, confidence and productivity. Tesluck's daily intake climbed gradually. "Very slowly, over time, I had to take just one more capsule or just one more dose, and then went all the way up to 100," she said. Her day-to-day functioning began to suffer, she shared. "I was not doing very well at work. I was getting … written up for performance." Physically, she had lost nearly 40 pounds and struggled to even stand in the shower "because my body was so wasted away." Tesluck’s belief that kratom was natural and legal made her growing dependence difficult to accept, she said. "About a year and a half into my kratom addiction from just the leaf … I finally realized I needed to do something, and I needed help." When she first sought treatment in 2020, Tesluck described feeling dismissed, saying that the facility’s urine test did not detect her use and that she had to explain what kratom was to the staff. "They were confused why I was there," she said. "So I left after just a few days because I felt kind of humiliated, and I went right back to my use." Tesluck found more help in 2021, when she attended an online recovery meeting. "I had nothing to lose," she said. "It changed everything for me to hear other people telling my story for the first time." After years of feeling alone in her addiction , she said, she finally felt surrounded by people who understood. In 2023, Tesluck relapsed following her grandmother’s death. "I was just grief-stricken. She was really close to me," she said. "So I went to the smoke shop just to get a little bit of kratom, just one time." She later experienced a separate relapse involving 7-OH , which she said followed the death of her cat and the end of a relationship on the same night. MEN AND WOMEN WHO SMOKE MARIJUANA MAY EXPERIENCE DIFFERENT EFFECTS, STUDY SUGGESTS 7-OH, short for 7-hydroxymitragynine, occurs naturally in trace amounts in kratom. Concentrated 7-OH products contain much higher levels than the leaf itself. The body converts some of kratom’s main active compound, mitragynine, into 7-OH, research shows. Both compounds act on opioid receptors and can contribute to dependence, according to the FDA. "The 7-OH was very strong," Tesluck said. "I stayed on that for just a few months because of how intense it was." She returned to her recovery group for support. "I had to take a leave of absence, and I got clean from 7-OH again with their help," she said. Having struggled with both leaf kratom and 7-OH, Tesluck views them as closely connected. "It’s one problem at two strengths," she said. ‘SUPER-DRUG’ 10 TIMES STRONGER THAN FENTANYL LINKED TO DEATHS ACROSS MULTIPLE STATES Mac Haddow, senior fellow on public policy for the American Kratom Association, disputed this characterization of leaf kratom and concentrated 7-OH. In comments to Fox News Digital, he argued that the body’s conversion of mitragynine into 7-OH does not produce equivalent exposure to concentrated products. Haddow also raised the possibility that the capsules Tesluck initially consumed may have contained ingredients beyond natural leaf kratom. Kratom rules vary widely across the country, with states taking different approaches to age restrictions, product standards and bans. "It’s really been a patchwork," Tesluck said. "It’s different from state to state. Some states ban it, some states regulate it." Florida, for example, prohibits selling or providing kratom products to anyone under 21. Washington’s health department says unscheduled kratom products remain largely unregulated there, without age restrictions, labeling standards or ingredient-testing requirements. Texas law requires kratom product labels to include directions and a recommended serving size. Haddow also emphasized the need for consumer warnings, adding, "The American Kratom Association supports accurate labeling to warn consumers that kratom can cause dependence." "We support stronger enforcement across the board, and excise taxes on kratom products to fund that enforcement." CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR HEALTH NEWSLETTER In an October interview with Fox News Digital, Haddow also backed age restrictions. "Twenty-one and up should be the only people who have access to these products," he said. Tesluck also raised concerns about how the products are marketed, describing social media ads as looking "very harmless" or "very cool," potentially drawing consumers’ interest. "It’s something that you might want to try just based on the marketing itself and the packaging," she warned. Tesluck said her work regularly brings her into contact with parents grieving children whose deaths they attribute to kratom products, including in states with Kratom Consumer Protection Acts. The FDA says no kratom drugs are approved by the agency, and that kratom cannot legally be marketed as a dietary supplement or added to conventional foods. In December 2025, federal authorities seized approximately 73,000 concentrated 7-OH products valued at roughly $1 million from three Missouri firms, according to the FDA. People taking kratom should pay attention to whether their use is beginning to dictate their daily routines, including planning around obtaining it or worrying about running out, Tesluck urged. CLICK HERE FOR MORE HEALTH STORIES "Like making sure when the smoke shop closes that you have enough time to get there," she said. Diminished appetite, weight loss and hair loss were among the effects Tesluck experienced. Other signs of problematic kratom use may include cravings, higher consumption than intended, unsuccessful attempts to stop and continued use despite problems at work or home, according to the National Institute on Drug Abuse. Feeling unable to miss a dose was another concern for Tesluck. "If I took less than what I was taking, I would feel even worse and sicker," she recalled. "So I was kind of stuck at that baseline with kratom." Haddow acknowledged that consumers can develop dependence or addiction. "Kratom can cause physical dependence, and some consumers have reported they develop addiction to kratom," he told Fox News Digital. Feelings of sedation, numbness or irritability may also occur, Tesluck said. "I was kind of like a zombie shell of myself overall," she said. "I wasn’t really the same person, personality-wise. I was irritable. I was mean." TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ Today, Tesluck describes herself as a "person in long-term recovery from both kratom and 7-OH addiction." She serves as executive director of End Kratom Addiction, a Virginia-based nonprofit that aims to raise awareness of kratom-related risks and advocates for stronger regulation. "My advocacy looks a lot like meeting one-on-one with families … and coordinating resources for those who are still in addiction," she said.

items.title: Cuba’s rulers can shout at diplomats. They cannot silence the cry for freedom
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: GAESA's alleged $14.5 billion in financial accounts could cover every Cuban's salary for two years, yet Havana blames the U.S. at the United Nations.
items.content: The world is beginning to push back against the propaganda Havana has peddled for decades at the United Nations as the corruption, oppression and hypocrisy of its Communist rulers are exposed for all to see. But there is more work to do. Havana’s regime cronies are desperate to survive in the face of growing international pressure, and the free world must continue to confront their lies and expose their corruption until they no longer hold power. For the first time in 31 years, under the leadership of President Trump, a third of the world declined to support Havana’s sham anti-embargo resolution at the U.N. 63 nations refused to vote with the Cuban regime, more than double last year’s number. By way of comparison: only two countries voted against Cuba during all four years of the Biden administration — and the U.S. even voted with Cuba under Obama. TRUMP EXPANDS CUBA SANCTIONS BEYOND US COMPANIES IN MAJOR CRACKDOWN ON FOREIGN ENABLERS Two weeks ago, I stood before the General Assembly and asked Cuba’s robber-barons a few simple questions. Why do they wear Rolexes while their people struggle to buy groceries? Why do their families have yachts and private islands while hospitals run out of medicine? Why does their military conglomerate control billions while ordinary Cubans sit in the dark? The regime’s "diplomats" responded by pounding their desks, shouting and trying to intimidate me. Their foreign minister marched toward the podium. And their first secretary confronted an American diplomat who discovered that the Cubans were trying to get the U.N. to cut my microphone. SHOUTING MATCH ERUPTS AT UN AS CUBAN FOREIGN MINISTER MOVES TOWARD US AMBASSADOR'S PODIUM: 'BACK UP!' They had plenty of theatrics and outrage. But not a single answer. And this is what I told the Assembly: If this is how the regime acts at the U.N. in a room full of diplomats, just imagine how they treat people on the island who bravely speak out. So, what are they so afraid of? MIKE WALTZ REVEALS CUBAN DIPLOMAT SHOVED US STAFFER, SLAPPED PHONE AWAY IN EXPLOSIVE UN CLASH For 67 years, the Castro regime has blamed America for the suffering it has inflicted on its own people. When Fidel Castro seized power, he confiscated businesses and farms, sent his opponents before firing squads and shipped them to forced-labor camps. Generations fled across the Florida Straits and so many more never made it out. Today, thanks to the regime, families endure blackouts lasting days . Hospitals lack basic medicine. And more than 800 political prisoners languish behind bars. CUBA PLUNGES INTO TOTAL BLACKOUT AS ELECTRICAL GRID COLLAPSES AGAIN, US EMBASSY WARNS During October 28’s proceedings, José Daniel Ferrer (who was imprisoned, released and then imprisoned again for demanding freedom) joined me at the General Assembly, watching from the gallery. The week before, I hosted another recently freed political prisoner at the U.N., Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara, who spent five years behind bars for advocating for freedom and creating art the regime didn’t like. These are the Cubans the world should be listening to. Their message: the world stands with the regime every time it votes for Cuba’s "embargo" resolution. TODAY’S LEFTISTS ARE DANGEROUSLY WRONG ABOUT COMMUNISM. JUST LISTEN TO THE SURVIVORS And then there’s the money. Investigative reporting by the Miami Herald's Nora Gámez Torres exposed financial records of GAESA , Cuba's military-run conglomerate. The records suggested $18 billion in current assets, including $14.5 billion in financial accounts. That $14.5 billion could cover every single Cuban’s salary for two years straight. It could buy 2 billion gallons of gasoline at Havana prices. Or, it could even stock every single Cuban pharmacy for 43 years at the regime’s own projected costs. The regime pockets billions more from the wholesale confiscation of wages taken from the nurses, doctors and soldiers it sends around the world. If they don’t cooperate, the regime threatens their families. I WAS LUCKY ENOUGH TO ESCAPE CUBAN SOCIALISM. AMERICA’S 250TH REMINDS ME WHY Meanwhile, the Castro family enjoys exclusive compounds, luxury yachts and a private island retreat complete with a marina and dolphin lagoon. Fidel famously wore two Rolexes. His descendants vacation in Europe while ordinary Cubans risk their lives trying to escape. Instead of answering for any of this, Havana cries "blockade." But, there is no American naval cordon around Cuba. Ships arrive from dozens of countries around the world. In the first eight months of 2026, American businesses exported more than $876 million in goods to Cuba. That includes $231.7 million in fuel — so much fuel, in fact, that the U.S. is now the largest supplier of fuel to Cuba’s private sector. Naturally, the regime objects to that very phrase: "private sector." But that’s precisely the point. American fuel should power a Cuban farmer’s tractor instead of a Castro grandson’s BMW. And American medicine should reach sick children instead of disappearing into the hands of Cuban elites. Since 1992, the regime has used this vote in the U.N. General Assembly as a layup against America — and against its own people. Every year, it parades the vote before the Cuban people on state TV to propagate the lie that the world stands with the regime, that Havana is the victim and that America is to blame for the Cuban people’s misery. In 2024, only 3 countries voted no or abstained. This year, that number is over 60 countries strong and growing as we continue to expose the regime’s corruption and oppression. So, here’s my challenge to every freedom-loving nation — and to every American who believes the Cuban people deserve better: keep demanding answers about the stolen billions, the prisoners still in jail and the corruption in plain sight. And when the regime demands your pity, remember the suffering of its people and the opulence it wants you to ignore. The Cuban people will be free. And I pray they finally taste freedom on President Trump and Secretary Rubio’s watch. Cuba Libre.

items.title: NFL Week 10 Sunday takeaways: Bengals look unbeatable, Chiefs are scary again, DeMeco Ryans is on the hot seat
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Takeaways from each game on Sunday during Week 10 of the NFL season, including why the rest of the league should be scared of the Chiefs and Bengals.
items.content: The NFL gave us another Sunday full of reasons to change our minds. Some teams are making it easier to believe in them, while others are making it harder to remember why we ever did. I'll try to make sense of it all, which is a generous description of what usually happens in this column. Here's my biggest takeaway from each game on the Week 10 Sunday slate. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE Takeaway: The Patriots' season is over. That might seem harsh for a team at 5-5 and still very much in the playoff picture, but New England is coming off a Super Bowl appearance, and any hope of a repeat trip is dead. Drake Maye left with an ankle injury, A.J. Brown was hurt again, and the defense is a complete disaster. New England benefited from a weaker AFC last season due to injuries to several star quarterbacks. This year’s path looks considerably tougher. Buffalo, Cincinnati and Kansas City are just way better than New England. Thus, the season is over. Takeaway: The Purple People Eaters are back. It's not often that I admit when I'm wrong, but I left the Vikings off my list of serious Super Bowl contenders after Week 9. I didn't think the offense, even after the Kirk Cousins trade, was good enough. But it might not matter. One week after the Packers scored 45 points against the Patriots, the Vikings made Green Bay's offensive line look like it was playing a man down. Jordan Love had never been sacked more than five times in a game. Minnesota finished with eight, all before the fourth quarter even started. With a defense like that, the offense simply needs to be competent. And it looked plenty competent with Cousins on Sunday at Lambeau. Takeaway: The Jaguars did what they were supposed to do. Jacksonville is the media darling in the AFC, with many suggesting this team is a Super Bowl contender. I'm still not buying it. Look, they did what they were supposed to do on Sunday: go into Tennessee and beat up on a clearly inferior team. Good for them. But to me, the Jags have only one quality win this season: their victory over the Bengals. Other than that, they've feasted on a very easy schedule while playing in a weak division. I still want to see this team against tougher competition, so I'm looking forward to their trip to Chicago to face the Bears on Dec. 6. Takeaway: The Kansas City Chiefs are as dangerous as ever. I'm not going to go overboard praising the Chiefs for beating the Falcons, but there were a couple of key developments beyond the final score. The first is that new addition Josh Downs fit seamlessly into the offense and made a nice touchdown grab. The second is that the Chiefs clearly have two talented and explosive running backs. With Kenneth Walker out with a groin injury, Emmett Johnson balled out with 171 total yards and two touchdowns. One thing that held the Chiefs back last season was a lack of playmakers on offense. Well, they added Walker in free agency, drafted Johnson and traded for Downs. Suddenly, the cupboard is very full in Kansas City. And that should be scary for the rest of the NFL. Takeaway: I can't wait for Thanksgiving night. What else is there to say? The Jets stink and the Bills are elite. We already knew both of these things. The key, though, is that Buffalo really hasn't been tested this season. Their lone loss came against a Patriots team that doesn't look very good. Their two best wins came against the Lions and Rams, but neither team was playing as well then as it is now. Yes, they beat the Vikings, but Minnesota started Carson Wentz . ZERO BS. JUST DAKICH. TAKE THE DON'T @ ME PODCAST ON THE ROAD. DOWNLOAD NOW! Nothing changes next week when Buffalo hosts Miami. But then the Chiefs come to town on Thanksgiving night for what could be the swing game in the battle for the No. 1 seed in the AFC. Get your popcorn ready. Takeaway: Bad teams find ways to lose. To be fair to Miami, it's better to lose and set yourself up for a better draft pick than to win games at this point. And give Jeff Hafley credit: the Dolphins are playing hard for their rookie head coach. But this was a game they really should have won. Miami outgained Indianapolis, had more first downs and won the turnover battle. But kicker Zane Gonzalez missed two field goals and an extra point, leaving seven points on the field in a two-point loss. Like I said, bad teams find ways to lose. Takeaway: What happened to Houston's defense? Yes, C.J. Stroud and the Texans offense deserve plenty of blame. Here's what that unit did in the second half: punt, punt, punt, punt, touchdown, punt, punt, turnover on downs. Outside of the one touchdown drive, Houston gained just 11 yards on its other seven possessions. All that being said, the offense gave the defense a 17-0 lead against Deshaun Watson and the Cleveland Browns. Honestly, that should have been enough; this was one of the best defenses in the NFL last season. Instead, they allowed 27 points over the final three quarters and a game-winning touchdown drive in the final two minutes. Credit to Watson for once again showing up in crunch time, but head coach DeMeco Ryans, known as a defensive genius, should find his seat very, very warm after this start to the season, particularly on defense. Takeaway: Someone has to win the NFC South, and the Panthers are now in control. This game had a tremendous ending, though neither team played particularly well. The teams combined for 20 points in the final four minutes, including Ryan Fitzgerald's game-winning 54-yard field goal as time expired. But the Panthers committed a ridiculous 17 penalties for 152 yards, the Saints turned the ball over twice and the teams combined for just 407 total yards through the first 56 minutes. Carolina now leads the NFC South, which appears to be a battle for which team gets to lose at home in the wild-card round. Takeaway: Survive and advance. I wrote earlier this week that the Rams just needed to survive long enough for Puka Nacua and Davante Adams to get healthy and return to the lineup. They had no problem doing exactly that against a bad Cardinals team. The offense looked explosive, and the defense forced multiple turnovers. The problem is that the easy stretch of the schedule is over after four straight wins over the Raiders, Chargers, Commanders and Cardinals. After next week's bye, the Rams face the Packers, Chiefs and 49ers. If the Rams can sneak into the playoffs, they're a potentially dangerous team. But the upcoming stretch is going to determine whether that's possible. Takeaway: Fernando Mendoza at least makes the Raiders more interesting. Mendoza made his first career NFL start after Las Vegas traded Kirk Cousins to Minnesota following Week 9. He wasn't able to lead the team to a victory, but there were plenty of positives to take from the start. Mendoza adds a rushing element to the Raiders offense that didn't exist under Cousins. He used his feet to pick up yards and extend plays while looking downfield. The offense looked good on its first couple of drives, but a first-quarter ankle injury to star tight end Brock Bowers left the rookie without his best weapon for the second half. One thing Mendoza needs to learn quickly, though, is when a play is over. The rookie took some big hits when he'd have been better off sliding or getting out of bounds. Takeaway: I'm running out of ways to say the 49ers are really good. San Francisco has dealt with a litany of injuries this season but hasn't missed a beat. The 49ers traded for Keenan Allen to shore up a wide receiver group hit particularly hard by the injury bug, and he made an immediate impact with four catches for 53 yards in his first half as a 49er. Deebo Samuel returned from injury and had a 70-yard touchdown run on a reverse. Christian McCaffrey finished with 223 yards from scrimmage and three touchdowns, including touchdown catches of 74 and 66 yards. And backup running back Kaelon Black trucked two Cowboys defenders on a 25-yard touchdown run. Black's presence has allowed San Francisco to manage McCaffrey's workload, helping keep the veteran fresh for a potential Super Bowl run. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! Brock Purdy is playing like an MVP and deserves significant consideration for the award. Through nine games, the 49ers have spent nearly 371 minutes leading and just 81 minutes trailing. That's more than four and a half times as much time playing from ahead as playing from behind. San Francisco has the inside track for the No. 1 seed in the NFC, and it's hard to imagine many teams capable of going into Levi's Stadium and beating this squad in January. Takeaway: When Cincinnati plays like that, there's no team in the NFL that can beat them. The Bengals' performance against the Steelers on Sunday Night Football was a masterclass in how to play football. Period. Heading into the fourth quarter, Cincinnati had outgained Pittsburgh 423-34. Joe Burrow had as many completions (34) as the Steelers had total yards. And here's the part that should worry the rest of the league: the problems that plagued the Bengals in recent seasons don't seem to exist right now. The question was never whether Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins are good enough to lead a Super Bowl offense. The question was whether the offensive line could give Burrow enough time to find those two stars. Well, against one of the best defensive fronts in the NFL, the Bengals offensive line completely dominated. Through three quarters, Pittsburgh had managed just one sack, and Burrow had 366 passing yards. The other question was whether the defense could get enough stops. Now, Pittsburgh's offense certainly isn't elite. Still, the Bengals stonewalled the run, pressured Aaron Rodgers and made plays on the ball the few times he had enough time to throw it. The Steelers entered the fourth quarter with just 2 net passing yards. The Bengals' best is simply better than any other team's best.

items.title: Defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks don't have a Drew Lock vs Sam Darnold quarterback controversy – yet
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Drew Lock posted a near-perfect 158.0 rating in the Seattle Seahawks' win, and his 3-0 record raises real questions about Sam Darnold's job.
items.content: The Seattle Seahawks have a bye week coming up and this is perfect because the injured quarterback that helped them win a Super Bowl last year can get closer to getting healthy and the backup quarterback who is undefeated this year is playing his best ball. So what a great time for a quarterback controversy. Sam Darnold versus Drew Lock. The guy who started when the team won the Super Bowl versus the guy who is undefeated in three starts this season! Except, well, no. Not yet. RAIDERS FANS STAY SEATED WHEN FERNANDO MENOZA SCORES A TD TO ALLOW HIS WHEELCHAIR BOUND MOM TO SEE SON CELEBRATE Dang it! Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald wasn't asked directly about the possibility of a controversy Sunday evening, after Lock led the Seahawks to a 21-13 victory over the Raiders by posting a near-perfect 158.0 quarterback rating (158.3 is perfect). But in answering a question about his quarterbacks, he made it pretty clear how he views the three players – Darnold, Lock and Jalen Milroe – in the room. "It's awesome, man," Macdonald said. "It's great. I think we have three really good quarterbacks. Drew's proven he's a great quarterback in our league. To be [3-0] is obviously a team stat, but, it's awesome, man. SEAHAWKS QB SAM DARNOLD SUFFERS HIP INJURY, RULED OUT JUST FIVE SNAPS INTO NFL SEASON "It's great that our starter goes down and nobody blinks an eye and guys have Drew's back, and we go play team football and go win. But Drew's played tremendously well. We're blessed. And shoutout to Drew for wanting this role." Before we read between the lines, understand the Seahawks are saying privately that Darnold will continue as the starter when he's healthy. Beyond that, notice that Macdonald says his starter goes down (Darnold) and says Lock has embraced or wanted the role he currently has as the backup. But this is the NFL, folks. And what is true now, may not be true in a month or even sooner. So let's explore that: Darnold has been sidelined since he suffered a cracked rib early in the game against the Chicago Bears on Nov. 2 and also had a quad injury on the final drive of that same game. He also missed time earlier in the season due to a glute/hip issue. Macdonald wants to see Darnold get some significant practice before returning him to the lineup. But here's the issue: What if that takes a while longer? And what if Lock continues on his current trajectory? How does Macdonald bench a quarterback who hasn't lost and hasn't thrown an interception in favor of one who has thrown 10 TDs and 9 interceptions this year, is coming back from an injury, and is 3-4 as a starter this season? Yeah ... not easy. Anyone with eyes around the NFL sees this as a potential issue for the Seahawks as long as Lock continues to get opportunities and respond as he has. Former Steelers head coach, Mike Tomlin, addressed the issue on the Sunday Night Football telecast. He made it very clear a coach such as Macdonald would never bench Darnold in favor of Lock after winning that Super Bowl with Darnold nine months ago. ZERO BS. JUST DAKICH. TAKE THE DON'T @ ME PODCAST ON THE ROAD. DOWNLOAD NOW! The two are simply invested in one another, Tomlin said. But ... "Sam's gotta get back on the deal very quickly," Tomlin added, "because he cannot allow Drew to continue to play like that." FOLLOW ARMANDO SALGUERO ON X: @ARMANDOSALGUERO

items.title: From torn ACLs to a headbutted wall, the worst self-inflicted NFL celebration injuries in history
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Aidan Hutchinson's sack celebration knee injury in Munich adds him to a painful list of NFL players who took themselves out on routine plays.
items.content: Aidan Hutchinson’s 2026 season is seemingly over after a freak injury, and it's not the first time we've seen a guy take himself out like this. On Sunday in Munich, the Lions edge rusher beat New England's left tackle in the first quarter, sacked New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye , and leaped into the air to celebrate. His right knee buckled the second his cleats hit the turf. Hutchinson grabbed his leg and limped to the locker room with what many fear is a season-ending right knee injury. DRAKE MAYE TELLS REPORTERS THEY DON'T KNOW 'WHAT THEY'RE TALKING ABOUT' DURING GERMANY PRESS CONFERENCE Two years after snapping his tibia and fibula in Dallas, Hutchinson knocked himself out for the year, setting up another long rehab for the Detroit star all over a first-quarter sack. The 26-year-old edge rusher now joins a painful list of NFL players who celebrated a routine play and couldn't stick the landing. With Hutchinson's mind-boggling injury , let's look back at the worst ways NFL guys have taken themselves out while celebrating. Lions fans have lived through this exact nightmare before. In Week 3 against Green Bay, the Detroit linebacker sacked Aaron Rodgers , mimicked Rodgers' "Discount Double Check" belt celebration, and tore his left ACL landing. His season ended right there because he wanted to troll a quarterback. One month after Tulloch went down, the Bears defensive end made an even worse business decision. Chicago trailed New England by 25 points in the fourth quarter when Houston sacked backup quarterback Jimmy Garoppolo , jumped to celebrate while getting blown out, and tore his ACL on the landing. The undisputed standard for self-inflicted NFL injuries. In the first quarter against the New York Giants, the Cardinals kicker drilled a basic 42-yard field goal, leaped into the air like he just won the Super Bowl, and tore his ACL coming down. His rookie year ended before halftime. Greenlaw suffered the worst-timed sideline injury in league history. During Super Bowl LVIII against the Kansas City Chiefs, the 49ers linebacker got too hyped up on the sideline after a punt, planted his foot to sprint onto the field, and ruptured his Achilles tendon before even taking a snap. San Francisco lost its starting linebacker mid-game and ended up losing the Super Bowl. After scoring a 1-yard rushing touchdown against the Giants on Sunday Night Football, the Washington quarterback jogged to the back of the end zone and decided to headbutt a lightly padded concrete wall. Shockingly, the wall didn't move. He sprained his neck, went to the hospital, and missed the second half. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! Brian Cushing (Houston Texans, 2011) The Texans linebacker took his helmet off against Cleveland and headbutted a helmeted Browns lineman with his bare skull, opening a huge gash on his forehead. The Patriots receiver spiked a touchdown ball so hard against Baltimore that he busted up his hand and had to leave the game. The veteran quarterback went down untouched in the end zone celebrating a 31-yard rushing score against Baltimore and fractured two ribs. Celebrations aren't the only way NFL players manage to take themselves off the field. League history is full of freak injuries that happened when nobody was even hitting them. The Lions receiver broke his arm in a 2:30 a.m. car crash while heroically reaching across his SUV to save a sliding pizza box. Honestly, risking an NFL season to protect two hot pies is deeply relatable. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE The wideout claimed he slipped on a McDonald's bag at home and put his right arm straight through an entertainment center, severing an artery, vein, nerve, and five tendons. Twelve seasons of NFL safeties couldn't stop him, but a rogue Quarter Pounder wrapper did. The pass rusher played bomb squad on America's birthday and blew up his right hand in a Fourth of July fireworks accident, losing part of his index finger before returning to the field with a massive club cast. In classic Detroit fashion, the former Lions tight end sprained his ankle and missed six games after wiping out while chasing his Pomeranian puppy down the stairs to save his carpet. items.author: پایگاه خبری جماران | اخبار روز ایران و جهان
items.preview: ورود دستگاه قضایی امارات به پرونده انتشار گزارش رویترز درباره زمان تکمیل دومین خط لوله نفتی ابوظبی به فجیره، پرسش‌هایی درباره محدودیت آزادی رسانه‌ها و تلاش دولت برای کنترل اطلاعات اقتصادی در شرایط جنگی ایجاد کرده است. پایگاه تحلیلی «لنز پست» در گزارشی انتقادی با بررسی احضار خبرنگ
items.content: ورود دستگاه قضایی امارات به پرونده انتشار گزارش رویترز درباره زمان تکمیل دومین خط لوله نفتی ابوظبی به فجیره، پرسش‌هایی درباره محدودیت آزادی رسانه‌ها و تلاش دولت برای کنترل اطلاعات اقتصادی در شرایط جنگی ایجاد کرده است. پایگاه تحلیلی «لنز پست» در گزارشی انتقادی با بررسی احضار خبرنگار رویترز و دست‌اندرکاران انتشار این خبر، استدلال می‌کند که حساسیت ابوظبی فراتر از اختلاف بر سر صحت یک گزارش اقتصادی است و به اهمیت راهبردی خطوط لوله جایگزین تنگه هرمز، نگرانی از پیامدهای جنگ بر صادرات نفت و تلاش برای حفظ تصویر امارات به‌عنوان یک مرکز اقتصادی امن ارتباط دارد. این گزارش با اشاره به اظهارات یکی از مدیران ارشد شرکت ژاپنی اینپکس، شریک تجاری ادنوک، درباره زمان تکمیل پروژه و برنامه احداث خط لوله سوم، تأکید می‌کند که برخورد قضایی با رسانه‌ها می‌تواند به تشدید خودسانسوری و کاهش پوشش مستقل تحولات اقتصادی امارات منجر شود.

items.title: زکات طلا چقدر است؟ بررسی نظر فقها و علمای شیعه و اهل سنت
items.author: علیرضا آقازاده
items.preview: پاسخ به پرسش «زکات طلا چقدر است؟» فقط دانستن یک درصد نیست. در احکام شرعی و فتواهای علمای شیعه و اهل سنت، نرخ یک‌چهلم یا ۲.۵ درصد مطرح است؛ اما ابتدا باید مشخص شود که چه مقدار از طلا مشمول پرداخت می‌شود. برخی ۱۵ مثقال معمولی معادل حدودا ۶۵ گرم و برخی ۸۵ گرم را […] The post زکات طل
items.content: پاسخ به پرسش «زکات طلا چقدر است؟» فقط دانستن یک درصد نیست. در احکام شرعی و فتواهای علمای شیعه و اهل سنت، نرخ یک‌چهلم یا ۲.۵ درصد مطرح است؛ اما ابتدا باید مشخص شود که چه مقدار از طلا مشمول پرداخت می‌شود. برخی ۱۵ مثقال معمولی معادل حدودا ۶۵ گرم و برخی ۸۵ گرم را به‌عنوان حد نصاب تعیین کرده‌اند. درباره زیورآلات نیز اتفاق‌نظر وجود ندارد. علمای شیعه تنها سکه‌هایی که به‌عنوان پول رایج استفاده شوند را مبنای نصاب قرار داده‌اند، اما برخی زیورآلات و طلای زینتی را نیز مشمول پرداخت زکات می‌دانند. به‌همین‌خاطر، برای محاسبه ابتدا باید نظر مرجع یا مذهب مورد پیروی خود را بررسی کنید. زکات طلا چقدر است و آیا به طلای شما تعلق می‌گیرد؟ مشابه حکم شرعی ارزهای دیجیتال ، نظر یکسانی بین علما، فقها و مراجع تقلید در خصوص میزان زکاتی که برای نگهداری و مالکیت طلا باید پرداخت کنید، وجود ندارد. این نظرها در چند چیز با یکدیگر تفاوت اساسی دارند: نصاب : مقدار طلایی که مشمول پرداخت زکات می‌شود. مبنای محاسبه : نحوه محاسبه و میزان زکاتی که باید پرداخت شود. نوع طلا : نوع طلا مانند زیورآلات‌ یا سکه که مشمول می‌شود. عیار : عیار مانند ۱۸، ۲۱ یا ۲۴ که در محاسبات زکات وارد می‌شود. مدت مالیکت: مدت زمانی که با نگهداری طلا مشمول پرداخت زکات می‌شوید. بنابراین، پیش از محاسبه، باید به فتوای مرجع تقلید خود مراجعه کنید. بااین‌حال، هنگام مطالعه نظر علما و فقهای شیعه و سنی، اعداد و ارقام خاصی به‌چشم می‌خورد که در اینجا به‌صورت خلاصه به آن‌ها می‌پردازیم. ۱. مبنای نصاب؛ وزن طلا از نظر میزان شمول یا همان نصاب ، اکثر علمای شیعه، ۲۰ مثقال شرعی معادل ۱۵ مثقال معمولی را تعیین کرده‌اند. در این نوع محاسبه، هر مثقال معمولی که همان مثقال صیرفی طلاست، برابر ۴.۶۰۸ گرم طلای ۱۷ عیار یا ۷۰۵ است. اگر بخواهیم مقدار آن را برای طلای ۱۸ عیار محاسبه کنیم، مقدار آن ۴.۳۳۱۸۰۲ گرم خواهد بود. برای مثال، آیت‌الله سیستانی و مکارم شیرازی، ۱۵ مثقال معمولی را به‌عنوان حد نصاب اول طلا تعیین کرده‌اند که برابر حدود ۶۴.۹۸ گرم طلای ۱۸ عیار است. اعدادی مانند ۸۵ گرم و ۸۷.۴۷۹ گرم نیز در فتواهای علمای سنی به‌چشم می‌خورند. یعنی اگر برای مثال شما بیش از ۸۵ گرم طلا داشته باشید، باید زکات آن را بپردازید و حتی ۱ سوت زیر این مقدار مشمول اساس اندازه مشهور حدود ۴.۶۰۸ گرم است. مثقال شرعی نیز طبق نظر مشهور، سه‌چهارم آن، یعنی حدود ۳.۴۵۶ گرم محاسبه می‌شود. این منبع، برآورد دیگری حدود ۴.۲۵ گرم برای مثقال شرعی را نیز گزارش کرده است. جدول تبدیل عیار، با ذکر مبنای محاسبه اگر مرجع تقلید شما عیار طلای مبنای محاسبه را ۲۴ دیگر عیارها ذکر کرده بود و شما طلای ۱۸ عیار داشتید، باید این دو را به یکدیگر تبدیل کنید. فرمول تبدیل به‌صورت زیر است:
